## What changes for the reader or user?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue if relevant.

## Evidence and checks

Explain how you checked the change. For content or advice, include sources and material limitations. For calculator changes, describe meaningful test cases. Say what could not be verified.

## Review checklist

- [ ] This change includes no private profile, journal, financial, or credential data.
- [ ] Claims, assumptions, and hypothetical examples are distinguishable.
- [ ] Generated output is rebuilt when source changes require it.
- [ ] Relevant checks pass, or their limits are explained above.
- [ ] Third-party material has appropriate permission and attribution.
